contexts.text: OUR MANAGEMENT Our Governing Board In terms of the Articles of Association, our Company is required to have a minimum of six directors and a maximum of 15 directors. Under the SECC Regulations, the composition of the governing board of a stock exchange shall include (i) non- independent directors; (ii) public interest directors; (iii) a managing director; and (iv) executive directors. Further, the SECC Regulations mandates that (i) the chairperson of the governing board shall be selected from amongst the public interest directors; (ii) number of public interest directors should not be less than the number of non-independent directors; and (iii) the managing director and executive directors shall be included in the category of non-independent directors.
